pm_persona_prompt: You are a world-class senior product manager that recently joined this project from a top software company. You will inspect everything about this product and recommend new features and improvements to the product council who will then implement it.

pm_recommendations.title: Industry NLE Timeline & Production Export Suite (EDL, FCPXML, CSV, Call Sheet)
pm_recommendations.problem_statement: Commercial directors and post-production editors reviewing pre-vis storyboards for 'Advanced Quantum Computing Silicon Proce' need direct timeline handoff into DaVinci Resolve, Premiere Pro, and Final Cut Pro without manual re-logging.
pm_recommendations.proposed_solution: Ship omni_director.tools.nle_export (CMX 3600 24fps EDL, FCPXML v1.10, CSV shot list, and Markdown Production Call Sheet) plus the `omni export` CLI subcommand.

pm_recommendations.title: SMPTE Dialogue Pacing Guardrail & Closed Caption Suite (SRT & WebVTT)
pm_recommendations.problem_statement: Over-stuffed spoken dialogue in 8-second clips causes accelerated lip-sync artifacts, and enterprise creative reviews require synchronized closed captions (SRT/VTT) and live animatic CC overlays.
pm_recommendations.proposed_solution: Ship omni_director.tools.dialogue with a 2.5 WPS speech-rate guardrail, SubRip (.srt) and WebVTT (.vtt) compilers, and an interactive #animatic-cc-hud overlay ([C] hotkey) in the Cinema UI.

pm_recommendations.title: Multi-Cam Coverage & Conversational Delta Branching Engine
pm_recommendations.problem_statement: Single-angle scene prompts limit editorial cutting flexibility; directors need A/B/C camera coverage (24mm Master Wide, 50mm Dynamic Hero, 100mm Macro Insert) and Turn 2-4 conversational edit deltas.
pm_recommendations.proposed_solution: Ship omni_director.tools.coverage (generate_scene_coverage & synthesize_conversational_deltas) and interactive .coverage-selector multi-cam tabs inside each scene card in the HTML5 animatic.

pm_recommendations.title: ASC CDL Color Science, Cinematic Look Presets & SVG Filter Grading Engine
pm_recommendations.problem_statement: Commercial directors, DPs, and colorists reviewing storyboards for 'Advanced Quantum Computing Silicon Proce' require industry-standard ASC CDL transfer functions (Slope, Offset, Power, Saturation) and established look presets (Kodak 5219, Fuji Eterna, Bleach Bypass, Teal & Orange) for DaVinci Resolve handoff rather than raw static hex codes.
pm_recommendations.proposed_solution: Implement AscCdlSpec and ColorLookSpec schemas, omni_director.tools.color_grade (Resolve CDL XML export and EDL SOP/SAT comments), and real-time SVG filter grading matrices in the HTML5 animatic.

pm_recommendations.title: Dynamic Speed Ramping, Shutter Angle & Motion Timing Engine
pm_recommendations.problem_statement: High-velocity commercial spots for 'Advanced Quantum Computing Silicon Proce' require dynamic speed ramping (time-warp keyframe curves) and explicit 180° / 90° shutter angle calibration to eliminate temporal smearing or stutter in Gemini Omni video generation.
pm_recommendations.proposed_solution: Implement SpeedRampCurveSpec, shutter timing camera grammar in CraftCameraSpec, omni_director.tools.speed_ramp (FCPXML timeMap export), prompt auditor shutter verification, and animatic velocity curve scrubbing.

pm_recommendations.title: Interactive Diegetic Stem Audio Mixer & Metering Console
pm_recommendations.problem_statement: Omni Director models high-fidelity 4-stem sound design (Dialogue, Foley, Ambience, BGM) for 'Advanced Quantum Computing Silicon Proce', but pitch reviews require interactive channel balance, solo/mute auditioning, and broadcast loudness (EBU R128 / ATSC A/85) compliance metering.
pm_recommendations.proposed_solution: Implement AudioStemMixerSpec, omni_director.tools.audio_mixer (DAW track manifests and loudness estimation), and a slide-out 4-channel audio mixing desk with Web Audio acoustic synthesis and canvas LED VU meters in the animatic.

pm_recommendations.title: Cinematic Optical Lens & Sensor Framing Suite (Anamorphic Squeeze, Focal Length, Hyperfocal Depth & Viewfinder Guides)
pm_recommendations.problem_statement: Directors of Photography and camera operators reviewing storyboards for 'Advanced Quantum Computing Silicon Proce' require precise optical modeling (sensor format crop factors, 1.33x/1.5x/2.0x anamorphic squeeze, horizontal field of view, hyperfocal distance) to avoid focal distortion in prompt generation, export lens metadata for ACs, and preview safe reticles directly in the animatic.
pm_recommendations.proposed_solution: Ship SensorFormat, AnamorphicSqueeze, OpticalLensSpec schemas, omni_director.tools.optical_lens (FOV and hyperfocal distance formulas, CSV metadata export, CRAFT optical prompt tokens), prompt auditor lens token verification, and Viewfinder Safe Guides HUD (#btn-viewfinder-animatic / #animatic-viewfinder-overlay [V] hotkey) in the HTML5 animatic.

pm_recommendations.title: Virtual Production LED Volume & Unreal Engine Stage Manifest / ICVFX Suite
pm_recommendations.problem_statement: High-end commercial productions for 'Advanced Quantum Computing Silicon Proce' increasingly film on curved LED volume stages with Unreal Engine 5 in-camera visual effects (ICVFX); production crews require nDisplay frustum tracking manifests, DMX lighting patch tables, and visual stage geometry blueprints directly from the storyboard bible.
pm_recommendations.proposed_solution: Ship LedWallGeometry, DmxLightingFixture, VirtualProductionStageSpec schemas, omni_director.tools.virtual_production (Unreal Engine nDisplay manifest JSON export, DMX lighting console patch CSV, frustum prompt tokens), and an interactive Virtual Production Stage Modal (#btn-vp-stage-animatic / #animatic-vp-stage-modal [P] hotkey) in the HTML5 animatic.

pm_recommendations.title: Kinetic Motion Control (MoCo) Rig & 6-DOF Camera Kinematics Engine
pm_recommendations.problem_statement: Complex kinetic camera maneuvers for 'Advanced Quantum Computing Silicon Proce' require precision mechanical motion control (Bolt Cinebot, Technocrane, Cablecam, Steadicam, FPV Drone) and 6-DOF trajectory waypoint tracking (X/Y/Z position, Roll/Pitch/Yaw orientation, velocity, acceleration) to guarantee repeatable camera paths and exportable camera tracking data for VFX pipelines (Nuke, Maya, Blender, Unreal Engine).
pm_recommendations.proposed_solution: Ship MotionControlRigType, TrajectoryWaypoint6DOF, MocoRigSpec schemas, omni_director.tools.moco_kinematics (path distance and velocity calculation, JSON, CSV, FBX ASCII camera transform exports), CRAFT camera MoCo prompt tokens, prompt auditor MoCo token verification, and an interactive MoCo Trajectory HUD (#btn-moco-animatic / #animatic-moco-hud [K] hotkey) in the animatic.

pm_recommendations.title: Volumetric Atmospheric & Studio Lighting Rig Simulator
pm_recommendations.problem_statement: High-end cinematic visuals for 'Advanced Quantum Computing Silicon Proce' require calibrated multi-point studio lighting (Key, Fill, Rim, Kicker, Practicals, Ambient) with color temperature (Kelvin), photometric illuminance (Lux), diffusion grades, particulate atmospheric haze/fog modeling, and lighting contrast ratios (Key:Fill, Key:Rim) to eliminate flat lighting and export gaffer setup call sheets.
pm_recommendations.proposed_solution: Ship LightingFixtureRole, DiffusionGrade, ParticulateHazeType, StudioLightFixtureSpec, AtmosphericHazeSpec, LightingRigSpec schemas, omni_director.tools.lighting_rig (Key:Fill & Key:Rim photometric contrast formulas, lighting plot JSON and gaffer equipment CSV exports), prompt auditor lighting tokens, and an interactive Studio Gaffer HUD (#btn-gaffer-animatic / #animatic-gaffer-hud [G] hotkey) in the animatic.

pm_recommendations.title: Domain-Calibrated Depth of Field (DoF), Iris Aperture & Optical Focus Engine
pm_recommendations.problem_statement: Commercial film genres for 'Advanced Quantum Computing Silicon Proce' require domain-specific optical focus depth behavior—from macro razor-thin depth of field in culinary ASMR (T1.4 on 100mm) and creamy 2x oval bokeh in luxury fashion portraiture (T1.8 on 85mm), to hyperfocal deep tracking in automotive action (T5.6 on 24mm) and panoramic infinite focus in architecture (T8.0 on 18mm)—to prevent optical inconsistency across scenes.
pm_recommendations.proposed_solution: Ship DomainDofSpec schema in omni_director.schemas, calibrate get_domain_dof_spec() across all 6 commercial domain archetypes in omni_director.presets, bind dof_spec to ScenePromptSpec and master_dof_spec to MasterProductionBible, and integrate domain DoF verification into ProductCouncilOrchestrator.

pm_recommendations.title: Domain 3D LUT Color Science & Film Emulation (.cube) Suite
pm_recommendations.problem_statement: Cinematic production pipelines for 'Advanced Quantum Computing Silicon Proce' require authentic color science and film stock emulation 3D LUTs (.cube)—such as warm Kodak 5219 Vision3 for culinary, bleach bypass silver for high-contrast fashion, metallic teal & orange for automotive, and cold surgical Rec.709 for cleanroom tech—to guide professional colorists and post-production grading.
pm_recommendations.proposed_solution: Ship DomainLutSpec schema in omni_director.schemas, calibrate get_domain_lut_spec() across all 6 commercial domain archetypes in omni_director.presets, bind lut_spec to ScenePromptSpec and master_lut_spec to MasterProductionBible, export 33x33x33 .cube metadata, and integrate 3D LUT verification into ProductCouncilOrchestrator.

pm_recommendations.title: Spatial Audio & Binaural Soundfield Acoustic Simulation (Dolby Atmos 7.1.4 & HOA Ambisonics)
pm_recommendations.problem_statement: Enterprise cinematic productions and game engines for 'Advanced Quantum Computing Silicon Proce' require physics-based spatial audio modeling—including 7.1.4 Dolby Atmos speaker beds, Higher-Order Ambisonics (HOA 3rd-order), Sabine and Eyring reverberation decay (RT60), wall material acoustic absorption coefficients, 3D Vector Base Amplitude Panning (VBAP), and Audio Definition Model (ADM) metadata—to eliminate flat stereo audio and deliver immersive binaural soundfields.
pm_recommendations.proposed_solution: Ship SpatialCoordinate3D, AcousticRoomImpulseResponse, SpatialAudioObjectSpec, and SpatialAudioSoundfieldSpec schemas, omni_director.tools.spatial_audio (Sabine/Eyring RT60 formulas, 7.1.4 VBAP matrix, ITU-R BS.2076 ADM JSON and Ambisonics CSV exports), CRAFT diegetic spatial audio prompt tokens, prompt auditor spatial compliance rules, and an interactive Spatial Audio Console (#btn-spatial-animatic / #animatic-spatial-hud [S] hotkey) in the dark-room animatic.

pm_recommendations.title: Advanced Multi-Pass VFX Compositing & Render Layer Manifest Engine (OpenEXR & Cryptomatte)
pm_recommendations.problem_statement: Professional studio VFX pipelines (Foundry Nuke, Maya, Blender, Unreal Engine) for 'Advanced Quantum Computing Silicon Proce' require multi-pass render layer decomposition—such as Beauty RGBA, Direct/Indirect Diffuse, Specular Reflection, Transmission/Refraction, Subsurface Scattering, Emission, Z-Depth, World Normals, Motion Vectors, and 32-bit Murmur3 hex-hashed Cryptomatte object/material IDs—to allow seamless live-action visual effects integration rather than un-decomposed flat video renders.
pm_recommendations.proposed_solution: Ship VfxRenderPassType, VfxLayerChannelSpec, CryptomatteManifestSpec, and VfxCompositingManifestSpec schemas, omni_director.tools.vfx_compositor (16/32-bit OpenEXR channel manifests, Murmur3 Cryptomatte hash generator, and Foundry Nuke .nk template generator), prompt auditor VFX compositing tokens, NLE bundle export, and an interactive Multi-Pass VFX Compositing HUD (#btn-vfx-animatic / #animatic-vfx-hud [X] hotkey) in the dark-room animatic.
